senses.gloss:
I. 1 Ā. (लोटते) 
__1 To resist, repel, oppose. 
__2 To shine. 
__3 To suffer pain. --II. 10 U. (लोटयति-ते) 
__1 To speak. 
__2 To shine. --III. 1, 4 P. (लोटति-लुट्यति) 
__1 To roll, wallow on the ground; cf. लुठ्. 
__2 To take away, rob, plunder (perhaps for लुण्ठ् or लुण्ट्).
A technical term used by Pāṇini to denote the First or Periphrastic Future or its terminations.
